CREATE TABLE daily_training_api_artifacts (
            daily_training_api_artifact_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            artifact_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            source_partition_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_page_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_page_kind IN
                ('monthly_archive','daily_date_fallback','sibling_month_archive')),
            page_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(page_no > 0),
            source_file_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_sha256)=64),
            ledger_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(ledger_sha256)=64),
            audit_script_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(audit_script_sha256)=64),
            audit_summary_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(audit_summary_sha256)=64),
            archive_manifest_path TEXT,
            archive_manifest_sha256 TEXT,
            profile_snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(profile_snapshot_sha256)=64),
            source_url_without_key TEXT,
            requested_at_ms INTEGER,
            retrieved_at_ms INTEGER,
            status_code INTEGER,
            api_result_code TEXT NOT NULL,
            raw_item_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(raw_item_count >= 0),
            profile_matched_row_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(profile_matched_row_count >= 0),
            excluded_nonprofile_row_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(excluded_nonprofile_row_count >= 0),
            quarantined_invalid_id_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quarantined_invalid_id_count >= 0),
            id_status_counts_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            quality_status_counts_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            event_date_min TEXT,
            event_date_max TEXT,
            inserted_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(source_partition_key, page_no),
            CHECK(raw_item_count = profile_matched_row_count + excluded_nonprofile_row_count),
            CHECK(quarantined_invalid_id_count <= excluded_nonprofile_row_count),
            CHECK((archive_manifest_path IS NULL AND archive_manifest_sha256 IS NULL) OR
                  (archive_manifest_path IS NOT NULL AND length(archive_manifest_sha256)=64))
        )

CREATE TABLE daily_training_api_rows (
            daily_training_api_row_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            daily_training_api_artifact_id INTEGER NOT NULL
                REFERENCES daily_training_api_artifacts(daily_training_api_artifact_id),
            source_row_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(source_row_index > 0),
            hrNo_raw TEXT,
            hrName_raw TEXT,
            meet_raw TEXT,
            trDate_raw TEXT,
            trTerm_raw TEXT,
            stTime_raw TEXT,
            spTime_raw TEXT,
            run1Cnt_raw TEXT,
            run2Cnt_raw TEXT,
            prGubun_raw TEXT,
            prNo_raw TEXT,
            part_raw TEXT,
            partNo_raw TEXT,
            trName_raw TEXT,
            chulGubun_raw TEXT,
            raw_row_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            horse_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            horse_profile_observation_id INTEGER NOT NULL
                REFERENCES horse_profile_observations(horse_profile_observation_id),
            profile_match_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(profile_match_status='verified_jeju_profile_id'),
            training_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(training_date)=10),
            start_time_local TEXT,
            start_time_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(start_time_status IN
                ('missing','valid_same_event_date','invalid_format_or_calendar','date_mismatch')),
            end_time_local TEXT,
            end_time_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(end_time_status IN
                ('missing','valid_same_event_date','invalid_format_or_calendar','date_mismatch')),
            time_order_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(time_order_status IN ('unavailable','ordered','reversed')),
            duration_seconds INTEGER CHECK(duration_seconds IS NULL OR duration_seconds > 0),
            duration_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(duration_status IN (
                'raw_zero_unavailable','positive_matches_valid_times','positive_time_mismatch',
                'positive_without_valid_times','missing_or_invalid_raw')),
            run1_count INTEGER,
            run1_count_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            run2_count INTEGER,
            run2_count_status TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(daily_training_api_artifact_id, source_row_index),
            CHECK((duration_seconds IS NULL) = (duration_status <> 'positive_matches_valid_times')),
            CHECK(run1_count IS NULL AND run2_count IS NULL)

CREATE TABLE race_section_order_reviews (
    api_record_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES race_result_rows(api_record_id),
    field_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (field_name IN (
        'sjS1fOrd','sj_1cOrd','sj_2cOrd','sj_3cOrd','sj_4cOrd','sjG1fOrd'
    )),
    review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (review_status='website_corrected'),
    api_order_at_review INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(api_order_at_review)='integer' AND api_order_at_review BETWEEN 1 AND 89),
    api_payload_sha256_at_review TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(api_payload_sha256_at_review)=64),
    website_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(website_order)='integer' AND website_order BETWEEN 1 AND 89),
    effective_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(effective_order)='integer' AND effective_order BETWEEN 1 AND 89 AND effective_order=website_order),
    website_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    checked_date_kst TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(evidence_sha256)=64),
    reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reason))>0),
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (api_record_id, field_name)
)

CREATE TABLE race_section_time_reviews (
    api_record_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES race_result_rows(api_record_id),
    field_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (field_name IN ('jeS1fTime','je_1cTime','je_2cTime','je_3cTime','je_4cTime','jeG3fTime','jeG1fTime')),
    review_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (review_status IN ('website_corrected','unresolved_official_website_anomaly')),
    api_seconds_at_review REAL NOT NULL,
    api_payload_sha256_at_review TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(api_payload_sha256_at_review)=64),
    website_display TEXT NOT NULL,

    effective_seconds REAL,
    website_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    checked_date_kst TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_relative_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(evidence_sha256)=64),
    decision_reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    applied_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(api_record_id, field_name),
    CHECK ((review_status='website_corrected' AND effective_seconds IS NOT NULL AND effective_seconds>0 AND effective_seconds=website_seconds)
        OR (review_status='unresolved_official_website_anomaly' AND effective_seconds IS NULL))
)

    raw_value_json_at_review TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_value_json_at_review)),

CREATE VIEW api_explicit_jeju_trial_rows AS

CREATE VIEW daily_training_api_rows_analysis_2026 AS
        WITH profile_ranked AS (
            SELECT horse_id, horse_name_raw, birth_date_raw,
                   row_number() OVER (
                       PARTITION BY horse_id
                       ORDER BY observed_at_utc DESC, api_record_id DESC
                   ) AS profile_rank
            FROM horse_profile_observations
        ), profile_current AS (
            SELECT horse_id, horse_name_raw, birth_date_raw,
                   CASE
                     WHEN length(trim(birth_date_raw)) >= 4
                      AND substr(trim(birth_date_raw), 1, 4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
                      AND CAST(substr(trim(birth_date_raw), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 2026
                     THEN CAST(substr(trim(birth_date_raw), 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
                   END AS current_horse_birth_year
            FROM profile_ranked WHERE profile_rank=1
        )
        SELECT r.daily_training_api_row_id, r.daily_training_api_artifact_id,
               r.source_row_index, r.horse_id, profile.horse_name_raw AS current_horse_name,
               profile.current_horse_birth_year,
               CASE
        WHEN length(trim(profile.birth_date_raw)) >= 4
         AND substr(trim(profile.birth_date_raw), 1, 4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
         AND CAST(substr(trim(profile.birth_date_raw), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 2026
        THEN 2026 - CAST(substr(trim(profile.birth_date_raw), 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
    END AS current_horse_age_2026,
               2026 AS current_horse_age_reference_year,
               r.training_date, r.hrName_raw AS horse_name_raw,
               r.trTerm_raw AS tr_term_raw, r.duration_seconds,
               CASE WHEN r.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL THEN r.duration_seconds / 60.0 END AS duration_minutes,
               r.duration_status, r.start_time_local, r.end_time_local,
               r.start_time_status, r.end_time_status, r.time_order_status,
               r.run1Cnt_raw, r.run1_count, r.run1_count_status,
               r.run2Cnt_raw, r.run2_count, r.run2_count_status,
               r.prGubun_raw, r.prNo_raw, r.part_raw, r.partNo_raw, r.trName_raw,
               r.chulGubun_raw, r.meet_raw, r.profile_match_status,
               r.horse_profile_observation_id, r.raw_row_json,
               a.source_partition_key, a.source_page_kind, a.page_no,
               a.source_file_path, a.source_sha256, a.requested_at_ms, a.retrieved_at_ms
        FROM daily_training_api_rows r
        JOIN daily_training_api_artifacts a USING (daily_training_api_artifact_id)
        LEFT JOIN profile_current profile ON profile.horse_id=r.horse_id
        WHERE r.training_date <= '2026-09-19'

CREATE VIEW jeju_race_candidate_corner_rank_coverage AS
SELECT c.race_date, c.meet_code, c.race_number,
       count(*) AS candidate_horse_rows,
       cr.api_record_id AS api303_api_record_id,
       CASE WHEN cr.api_record_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS api303_present,
       CASE WHEN cr.api_record_id IS NOT NULL AND (
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_1_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_2_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_3_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_4_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_5_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_6_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_7_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_8_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.corner_9_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '-', 'X')
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS api303_has_corner_order_content,
       CASE WHEN cr.api_record_id IS NOT NULL AND (
           coalesce(trim(cr.passtime_3f_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '0:00.0', '0:00') OR
           coalesce(trim(cr.passtime_4f_raw), '') NOT IN ('', '0:00.0', '0:00')
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS api303_has_nonzero_passing_time,
       cra.payload_sha256 AS api303_payload_sha256,
       sa.sha256 AS api303_source_page_sha256,
       sa.raw_relative_path AS api303_source_page_path
FROM jeju_race_population_candidates c
LEFT JOIN api303_corner_rank_rows cr
  ON cr.race_date = c.race_date
 AND cr.meet_code = c.meet_code
 AND cr.race_number = c.race_number
LEFT JOIN api_records cra ON cra.api_record_id = cr.api_record_id
LEFT JOIN source_artifacts sa ON sa.source_artifact_id = cra.source_artifact_id
GROUP BY c.race_date, c.meet_code, c.race_number

SELECT s.medical_api_diagnosis_slot_id, s.medical_api_row_id, s.api_record_id,
       s.source_artifact_id, s.source_row_no, s.horse_id, s.clinic_date,
       s.source_slot_ordinal, s.source_slot_kind, s.raw_diagnosis_text,
       s.normalized_diagnosis_text, s.raw_text_sha256,
       p.review_decision, p.review_status, p.original_match_status,
       p.reviewed_target_count, p.contextual_evidence_required,
       p.mapping_rule_scope, p.prefix_rule_reusable, p.event_link_policy,
       CASE
         WHEN s.raw_diagnosis_text IS NULL OR s.raw_diagnosis_text = ''
           THEN 'source_empty'
         WHEN s.raw_diagnosis_text = '-'
           THEN 'unknown_placeholder_dash'
         WHEN p.raw_text_sha256 IS NULL
           THEN 'no_exact_review_phrase'
         WHEN p.review_status = 'excluded'
           THEN 'excluded_review_metadata'
         WHEN p.review_status = 'confirmed_review_mapping'
          AND p.mapping_rule_scope = 'reviewed_phrase_candidate_only'
          AND p.contextual_evidence_required = 0
          AND p.prefix_rule_reusable IS NOT 0
          AND p.reviewed_target_count > 0
           THEN 'reviewed_exact_phrase_component_metadata_only'
         WHEN p.mapping_rule_scope IN ('event_specific_reference_only', 'prior_rpt_parser_context_only')
           OR coalesce(p.contextual_evidence_required, 1) <> 0
           OR p.prefix_rule_reusable = 0
           THEN 'hold_requires_new_in_scope_event_evidence'
         ELSE 'unresolved_review_metadata'
       END AS mapping_disposition,
       0 AS automatically_applied_to_event
FROM medical_api_diagnosis_slots AS s
LEFT JOIN medical_phrase_decisions AS p
  ON p.raw_text_sha256 = s.raw_text_sha256
 AND p.raw_text = s.raw_diagnosis_text
 AND s.raw_diagnosis_text IS NOT NULL
 AND s.raw_diagnosis_text <> ''
 AND s.raw_diagnosis_text <> '-'

CREATE VIEW starting_training_website_rows_analysis_2026 AS 
    WITH profile_ranked AS (
        SELECT horse_id, horse_name_raw, birth_date_raw,
               row_number() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY horse_id
                   ORDER BY observed_at_utc DESC, api_record_id DESC
               ) AS profile_rank
        FROM horse_profile_observations
    ), profile_current AS (
        SELECT horse_id, horse_name_raw, birth_date_raw
        FROM profile_ranked WHERE profile_rank=1
    )
    SELECT latest.*, profile.horse_name_raw AS current_horse_name,
           CASE
             WHEN length(trim(profile.birth_date_raw)) >= 4
              AND substr(trim(profile.birth_date_raw), 1, 4) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
              AND CAST(substr(trim(profile.birth_date_raw), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 2026
             THEN 2026 - CAST(substr(trim(profile.birth_date_raw), 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
           END AS current_horse_age_2026,
           2026 AS current_horse_age_reference_year
    FROM starting_training_website_rows_latest latest
    LEFT JOIN profile_current profile ON profile.horse_id=latest.horse_id
    WHERE latest.training_date <= '2026-09-19'
